last_result.headline: Q43 collected 12 sources, wrote 5 proposals, appended 3. The search was narrowed by Q40: every arm it tested was a SOFT PER-STEP penalty, so the target is path devices that are not. Established that the DP has NO global constraint -- it windows +-BAND around the previous state, leaving cumulative deviation unbounded with no slope limit. Appended q54 (hard Sakoe-Chiba corridor + Itakura slope limits as an admissibility mask -- a hard cap bounds deviation REGARDLESS of path length, the complement of what Q40 closed), q55 (beam-average + soft-min Bellman; Q21 found the deployed PF is already a softmax at T=5 at a nested optimum, never applied to the DP), q56 (PF backward smoothing -- the PF is forward-only yet the entire toe GR is observable at prediction time). Not appended: geometric transition scale (too close to Q40 drift, -11.475) and path-distribution output (subsumed by q55). Limit: the geosteering HMM search returned no geosteering results; material came from map-matching and general HMM/DTW literature.
